data.name: Undergone
data.detailed_description:
Undergone is a first-person single-player photography game set in stunning natural worlds.

Play as Kale, a teenager seeking escape from everyday life, as he sets out to capture the beauty of nature, only to uncover something far darker hidden beneath it. What begins as a peaceful journey to capture nature’s beauty slowly unravels into a haunting search for truth, memory, and the consequences left behind.

Capture the world’s beauty.

From quiet rivers and deep forests to distant mountains glowing beneath the night sky, every photo you take reveals another piece of this living world and hints at the truth it hides.

Step into a world of breathtaking nature… and watch it slowly unravel. As you journey through beauty and ruin, a single question follows you: who is destroying this place? Explore, uncover memories, and face the truth hidden just beyond the last photograph.

data.short_description: Explore a breathtaking world through photography and uncover the mystery behind its transformation. Each photo you take, and every step you make reveals the truth about your past and memories left behind. It is not just about taking photos, It is about what you choose to see.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i3-8100 / Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Ti / RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel i5-10400 / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 / RX 5600 XT
